reportedIssues.problem: On first focus the iOS keyboard covers the revision-instructions composer.
reportedIssues.cause: App shell uses layout height 100dvh without tracking the visual viewport used by the on-screen keyboard.
reportedIssues.fix: Bind shell/composer to measured visible viewport; preserve independent content scroll and restore full size after dismissal.

reportedIssues.problem: Subsequent focus leaves a dark gap in Paper appearance.
reportedIssues.cause: Native WKWebView background is fixed to Ink; keyboard and bottom safe-area space are not coordinated.
reportedIssues.fix: Synchronize native background with theme and avoid double bottom insets while keyboard is open.

reportedIssues.problem: WebView previous/next/done accessory toolbar occupies an unnecessary extra row.
reportedIssues.fix: Use supported Tauri with_input_accessory_view_builder returning None; retain compact dismissal in the composer.

designDecision: Floating rounded composer above the content plane, containing text and existing controls together; side margins, small keyboard gap, restrained frosted surface/shadow. Keep Alma colors. CSS frosting is not claimed to be native Apple Liquid Glass.
scope: Presentation only; Framework/Adapter/Backend and user tasks unchanged.

checks.keyboard: User-installed Sogou Chinese nine-key and English QWERTY
physicalChecks: First focus after cold app launch keeps textarea and controls fully above keyboard
Paper theme has no exposed dark band
Composer hide button dismisses keyboard and full layout returns
Chinese nine-key -> English QWERTY -> Chinese nine-key stays aligned
On-screen q input and deletion preserve focus; no instructions sent
Original draft restored to empty; settings checkpoint saved

limitations: Physical keyboard/layout checks cover this phone and its installed Sogou keyboard; other iOS/IME combinations are not claimed.
Frosted appearance is CSS backdrop-filter, not native UIGlassEffect.
